# Claude Code Tools

Tools are the actions that Claude can take, such as `Read`, `Edit`, `Bash`, and `WebFetch`.
Each tool has input fields, and three flags that tell Claude Code how to treat it.
For example, `Grep` is read-only and safe to run in parallel, so Claude Code can run many searches at once.

## Marks

| Mark | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| ✅ | A page of the [Claude Code docs](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/overview) names it. |
| 🔍 | Only the Claude Code bundle names it. No docs page does. |
| ⚠️ | The docs and the bundle differ. The row says how. |
| 🧪 | It works only behind a flag, a plan, or a server-side switch. The row says which. |
| ❌ | It is removed or does nothing in `2.1.303`. |

## Columns on the Tool Pages

The inventory `external/cc-diff-302-303/data/inv-2.1.303.json` lists 70 tools.
The bundle has more, such as `Agent`, `Monitor`, `ToolSearch`, `ScheduleWakeup`, and `StructuredOutput`.
Each tool page has three yes or no columns.

| Column | ✅ Means | ❌ Means |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Read-Only | The tool changes nothing, so Claude Code can skip some prompts for it. | The tool can change things, or the bundle sets no flag. |
| Parallel | Claude Code can run several calls of the tool at the same time. | Calls run one after the other, or the bundle sets no flag. |
| Deferred | The tool is not loaded at the start. Claude finds it with `ToolSearch` first. | The tool is loaded at the start. |

A tool with no flag in its definition shows ❌ for Read-Only and Parallel.
`Bash` and `PowerShell` also show ❌ for both, because the result depends on the command.

## ToolSearch

`ToolSearch` loads the full schema of a deferred tool, so that Claude can call it.
For example, the query `select:Read,Edit,Grep` fetches those three tools by name.

| Mark | Item | What It Does | How It Works | Where It Can Be Used | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ✅ | `ToolSearch` | Loads the full schema of deferred tools. | `query` (string, required) and `max_results` (int, optional, default 5). The result lists `matches`, `total_deferred_tools`, `pending_mcp_servers`, and `failed_mcp_servers`. | Main session and subagents. | [Tools Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/tools-reference), [Create Custom Subagents](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents) |
| ⚠️ | `max_results` | The old `2.1.296` capture showed it as required. | In `2.1.303` it is optional with the default `5`. | - | Bundle |
| 🔍 | Query `select:A,B` | Fetches the named tools. | The prompt gives `select:Read,Edit,Grep`. A tool that is already loaded returns a note. | - | Bundle |
| 🔍 | Query keywords | Searches by keyword and returns up to `max_results` matches. | The prompt gives `notebook jupyter`. | - | Bundle |
| 🔍 | Query `+term rest` | Requires `term` in the tool name and ranks by the rest. | The prompt gives `+slack send`. | - | Bundle |
| ✅ | Pending MCP servers | A search can wait for MCP servers that are still connecting. | Name the server as `mcp__server` in the query. | - | [Connect Claude Code to Tools via MCP](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp) |
| 🔍 | Placeholder | A dummy tool keeps deferred loading active. | The text tells Claude never to call it. | - | Bundle |
| ✅ | Deny rule | `permissions.deny` with `ToolSearch` turns it off. | Claude then uses `WaitForMcpServers`. | Settings | [Connect Claude Code to Tools via MCP](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp) |
| ✅ | Result note | A no-match result names the servers that failed. | `failed_mcp_servers` carries `name`, `errorCode`, and `error`. | - | [Connect Claude Code to Tools via MCP](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp) |

## Deferral Rules

Claude Code checks these rules in order to decide if a tool is deferred.

1. A hook or a server-side override can set the state first.
2. A tool with `alwaysLoad` set to `true` is not deferred.
3. A tool in the never-defer set is not deferred.
   The set holds `ToolSearch`, `StructuredOutput`, `Agent` when fork mode is on, the brief tool, `EnterWorktree` in a `bg` session, and `PushNotification` for a `remote_trigger` entry point.
   A server-side list can add more built-in tools.
4. An MCP tool is deferred.
5. A tool in a server-side defer list is deferred.
6. Otherwise the `shouldDefer` value of the tool decides.

| Mark | Item | What It Does | How It Works | Where It Can Be Used | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ✅ | `ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH` unset | MCP tools are deferred. | With a non-first-party `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` they load at the start. | Shell or `env` in settings | [Connect Claude Code to Tools via MCP](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp), [Environment Variables](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/env-vars) |
| ✅ | `ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH=true` | MCP tools stay deferred, also on a proxy host. | - | Same | [Connect Claude Code to Tools via MCP](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp), [Environment Variables](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/env-vars) |
| ✅ | `ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH=auto` and `auto:N` | Tools load at the start while their definitions fit in N percent of the window. | The default is 10. `auto:0` acts like `true`. `auto:100` acts like `false`. N stays between 0 and 100. | Same | [Connect Claude Code to Tools via MCP](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp) |
| ✅ | `ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH=false` | Every MCP tool loads at the start. | - | Same | [Connect Claude Code to Tools via MCP](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp) |
| ✅ 🧪 | `ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH=force` | Forces tool search on, also when betas are off. | Needs a first-party provider. | Same | [Connect Claude Code to Tools via MCP](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp), [Environment Variables](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/env-vars) |
| ✅ | `alwaysLoad` (server or tool `_meta`) | Exempts a tool or a whole server from deferral. | An MCP tool sets it from `anthropic/alwaysLoad`. | `.mcp.json`, plugin MCP config, server `_meta` | [Connect Claude Code to Tools via MCP](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp) |
| 🔍 🧪 | Server-side never-defer list | Names built-in tools that must never be deferred. | The default is an empty list. A hidden server-side flag sets it. | Set by Anthropic | Bundle |
| 🔍 🧪 | Server-side defer list | Defers `ReportFindings`, `Workflow`, and `ShareOnboardingGuide`. | A hidden server-side flag sets it. | Set by Anthropic | Bundle |

### Which Built-In Tools Are Deferred

- Deferred: `WebFetch`, `WebSearch`, `NotebookEdit`, `TodoWrite`, `LSP`, `Monitor`, `EnterPlanMode`, `ExitPlanMode`, `EnterWorktree`, `ExitWorktree`, `TaskCreate`, `TaskGet`, `TaskUpdate`, `TaskList`, `TaskStop`, `SendMessage`, `SendFile`, `CronCreate`, `CronDelete`, `CronList`, `PushNotification`, `RemoteTrigger`, `EndConversation`, `ProposeGoal`, `FetchInboxMessage`, `PublishPlugin`, `OfferChromeSetup`, `DesignSync`, `SearchMcpRegistry`, `SuggestConnectors`, `ListConnectors`, the three MCP resource tools, and the nine runner tools.
- A runtime check decides: `SuggestPluginInstall`, `SuggestSkills`, `SendUserFile`.
- Not deferred: `Read`, `Write`, `Edit`, `Glob`, `Grep`, `Bash`, `PowerShell`, `Agent`, `Skill`, `AskUserQuestion`, `ListAgents`, `Workflow`, `ReportFindings`, `ToolSearch`, `StructuredOutput`, `SubagentHandback`, `ScheduleWakeup`, `memory_*`, and the rest of the [Other](Claude-Code-Tools-Other) page.
- The old capture of `2.1.296` lacked `Glob` and `Grep`.
  In `2.1.303` they are not deferred, so they load with a full schema when the tool is offered.

## Common Properties

- `backgrounding` is `never`, `self`, or `detach`.
  `self` means the tool backgrounds itself: `Bash`, `PowerShell`, `Agent`.
  `detach` applies to `WebFetch` and `WebSearch`.
- `maxResultSizeChars` is 100000 for most tools, 20000 for `Grep`, and unbounded for `Read`.
- `strict` is true for `Write`, `Edit`, `Read`, `Grep`, `Bash`, `PowerShell`, `TodoWrite`, and `ReportFindings`.
- An MCP tool is named `mcp__<server>__<tool>`.
  See [MCP](Claude-Code-MCP).
